changes.after:
# Use a real bridge on the native input path, retaining every physical via loop.
resistor_rows=[(i,line.split()) for i,line in enumerate(rows) if re.fullmatch(r'R\d+ \S+ \S+ \S+',line)]
assert len(resistor_rows)==len(parsed['resistors']) and len(resistor_rows)>0
assert nx.number_connected_components(graph)==9 and 'P_ip' in anchor
input_terminals=[n for n in anchor if n.startswith('T') and n.endswith('_B') and anchor[n]==anchor['P_ip']]
assert len(input_terminals)==1
input_terminal=input_terminals[0]
native_path=nx.shortest_path(graph,'P_ip',input_terminal)
bridges={frozenset(edge)for edge in nx.bridges(graph)}
path_edges=[frozenset((x,y))for x,y in zip(native_path,native_path[1:])]
candidates=[edge for edge in path_edges if edge in bridges and sum(frozenset(f[1:3])==edge for i,f in resistor_rows)==1]
assert candidates,'Actual input requires a distinct native bridge for single-resistor open control'
drop_index,drop_fields=next((i,f)for i,f in resistor_rows if frozenset(f[1:3])==candidates[0])
dropped_rows=rows[:drop_index]+rows[drop_index+1:]
dropped_text='\n'.join(dropped_rows)+'\n'
dropped_parsed=m.rawparser.parse_spice(dropped_text)
assert len(dropped_parsed['resistors'])==len(parsed['resistors'])-1
broken=nx.Graph();broken.add_nodes_from(graph.nodes);broken.add_edges_from((x,y)for x,y,v in dropped_parsed['resistors'])
assert not nx.has_path(broken,'P_ip',input_terminal)
assert nx.number_connected_components(broken)==10
assert all(any(n in anchor for n in comp)for comp in nx.connected_components(broken))
duplicate_text=text.replace('.ends','R_EXTRA_SAME_CONDUCTOR '+drop_fields[1]+' '+drop_fields[2]+' '+drop_fields[3]+'\n.ends')
duplicate_parsed=m.rawparser.parse_spice(duplicate_text)
assert len(duplicate_parsed['resistors'])==len(parsed['resistors'])+1 and duplicate_text!=text
assert 'P_inn' in anchor and anchor['P_ip']!=anchor['P_inn']
